<!-- Source page: Artwork -->

This page serves as a space to highlight creative works produced by members of the NixOS community. It includes unofficial artwork such as wallpapers, illustrations, and other visual expressions inspired by NixOS. While official branding materials are maintained in the [nixos/branding](https://github.com/NixOS/branding) repository, this page is intended to recognize and celebrate the broader community’s enthusiasm and creativity.
